description: Create a campaign DRAFT — the sequence SHELL only. ⚠️ IT HOLDS NO COPY: the subject and body live on a VARIANT, which you add with send_add_step / send_add_variant. Nothing here sends anything and nothing here arms it — a human arms a campaign in the dashboard, and there is no tool for that on purpose. Recommended order: create → add steps (each with its variant) → send_attach_source → send_preview_step on every step → tell your human it is ready to activate. Note stop_condition admits only reply|click: 'open' is excluded because Apple MPP fires open pixels with no human involved, so stopping on one stops on noise.

active_days.description: ISO weekday numbers, 1=Mon..7=Sun (default Mon-Fri). ⚠️ NOT the mailbox's own send days — these are two different clocks and BOTH must allow a day for mail to leave.

company_pause.description: Pause every lead at a company as soon as one of them replies.

include_postal_address.description: Default TRUE. With it on, the send path REFUSES if this workspace has recorded no physical postal address (Settings → Information).

include_unsubscribe.description: Default TRUE. Gates the visible unsubscribe FOOTER (CAN-SPAM). The RFC-8058 headers are transport and ship regardless. Turn it off only if you know why.

new_leads_per_day.description: Enrolment throttle. Omit for no campaign-level cap (the mailbox still paces).

starts_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the first day enrolment may begin.

stop_condition.description: What ends a lead's sequence (default 'reply'). 'open' is deliberately not offered.

timezone.description: IANA zone the campaign clock runs on (default 'UTC').

track_opens.description: Default FALSE — open data is unreliable; do not score engagement on it.

variant_strategy.description: How an arm is chosen at enrolment (default round_robin).

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_create_campaign
